rule.title: Classe Apex sans declaration de partage explicite
rule.description: Detecte une classe (hors test et interface) qui ne declare ni 'with sharing', ni 'without sharing', ni 'inherited sharing'.
rule.rationale: Une classe sans declaration de partage herite par defaut des regles de l'appelant, ce qui introduit un risque d'exposition de donnees. Le pilier Trusted du Well-Architected Framework recommande un controle d'acces explicite aux donnees.
rule.remediation: Ajouter 'with sharing' (ou 'inherited sharing' quand le contexte appelant doit etre respecte) sur la declaration de la classe.

translation.title: Apex class without an explicit sharing declaration
translation.description: Detects a class (test classes and interfaces excluded) that declares neither 'with sharing', nor 'without sharing', nor 'inherited sharing'.
translation.rationale: A class without a sharing declaration inherits the caller's rules by default, which introduces a data exposure risk. The Trusted pillar of the Well-Architected Framework recommends explicit access control over data.
translation.remediation: Add 'with sharing' (or 'inherited sharing' when the calling context must be honoured) to the class declaration.

rule.title: Identifiant Salesforce code en dur
rule.description: Detecte la presence d'un Id Salesforce 15/18 caracteres ecrit en dur dans le code.
rule.rationale: Les Ids differencient les environnements. Un Id code en dur provoque des regressions lors des deploiements Sandbox -> Production et nuit a la portabilite du code.
rule.remediation: Externaliser l'identifiant dans une Custom Metadata, un Custom Setting ou un label, et le resoudre a l'execution.

translation.title: Hardcoded Salesforce ID
translation.description: Detects a 15/18 character Salesforce ID written directly in the code.
translation.rationale: IDs differ between environments. A hardcoded ID causes regressions during Sandbox -> Production deployments and hurts code portability.
translation.remediation: Move the identifier into Custom Metadata, a Custom Setting or a label, and resolve it at runtime.

rule.title: Risque d'injection SOQL detecte
rule.description: Detecte l'utilisation de Database.query() avec une chaine de caractere construite dynamiquement sans echappement visible.
rule.rationale: L'injection SOQL permet a un attaquant de manipuler les requetes pour acceder a des donnees non autorisees. L'utilisation de variables de liaison (:var) ou de String.escapeSingleQuotes() est indispensable pour les requetes dynamiques.
rule.remediation: Utiliser des variables de liaison (bind variables) ou appliquer String.escapeSingleQuotes() sur les variables concatenees dans la requete.

translation.title: SOQL injection risk detected
translation.description: Detects the use of Database.query() with a dynamically built string and no visible escaping.
translation.rationale: SOQL injection lets an attacker manipulate queries to reach unauthorised data. Bind variables (:var) or String.escapeSingleQuotes() are mandatory for dynamic queries.
translation.remediation: Use bind variables, or apply String.escapeSingleQuotes() to the variables concatenated into the query.

rule.source: Well-Architected Data Security + Salesforce Security Guide
rule.title: Absence de controle CRUD/FLS explicite
rule.description: Detecte des operations DML ou SOQL sans clause de securite explicite (WITH USER_MODE, Security.stripInaccessible, etc.).
rule.rationale: Par defaut, l'Apex s'execute en mode systeme. Sans controle explicite, un utilisateur peut modifier ou lire des champs auxquels il n'a pas droit via l'interface standard. Le Well-Architected Framework (Trusted > Secure) recommande d'appliquer les permissions de l'utilisateur.
rule.remediation: Ajouter 'WITH USER_MODE' aux requetes SOQL ou utiliser 'Security.stripInaccessible()' pour les operations DML, ou encore verifier explicitement les droits via Schema.SObjectType.

translation.title: No explicit CRUD/FLS enforcement
translation.description: Detects DML or SOQL operations without an explicit security clause (WITH USER_MODE, Security.stripInaccessible, etc.).
translation.rationale: Apex runs in system mode by default. Without explicit enforcement a user can read or update fields they are not entitled to through the standard UI. The Well-Architected Framework (Trusted > Secure) recommends applying the running user's permissions.
translation.remediation: Add 'WITH USER_MODE' to SOQL queries, use 'Security.stripInaccessible()' for DML operations, or check the rights explicitly through Schema.SObjectType.

rule.title: Aucun try/catch autour de traitements DML ou SOQL
rule.description: La classe contient au moins un DML ou SOQL mais aucun bloc try/catch n'est detecte.
rule.rationale: Un composant fiable protege l'utilisateur des erreurs techniques. Sans gestion d'exception, une erreur DMLException ou QueryException provoque une trace brute et potentiellement une transaction incoherente pour l'utilisateur final.
rule.remediation: Encadrer les acces aux donnees avec try/catch, logger l'erreur via un service de logs et renvoyer un message lisible a l'appelant.

translation.title: No try/catch around DML or SOQL processing
translation.description: The class contains at least one DML or SOQL statement but no try/catch block was detected.
translation.rationale: A reliable component shields users from technical errors. Without exception handling a DMLException or QueryException surfaces as a raw stack trace and can leave the transaction inconsistent for the end user.
translation.remediation: Wrap data access in try/catch, log the error through a logging service and return a readable message to the caller.

rule.title: SOQL potentiellement execute dans une boucle
rule.description: Une requete SOQL apparait dans une boucle 'for' ou 'while', ce qui epuise rapidement les gouverneurs.
rule.rationale: Les limites Apex (100 SOQL/transaction) sont un plafond strict. Un SOQL dans une boucle atteint la limite en quelques iterations et fait echouer la transaction.
rule.remediation: Extraire la requete de la boucle et bulkifier le traitement (SOQL unique qui retourne une collection, traitee ensuite en memoire).

translation.title: SOQL potentially executed inside a loop
translation.description: A SOQL query appears inside a 'for' or 'while' loop, which quickly exhausts governor limits.
translation.rationale: Apex limits (100 SOQL per transaction) are a hard ceiling. A SOQL inside a loop reaches the limit within a few iterations and fails the transaction.
translation.remediation: Move the query out of the loop and bulkify the processing (a single SOQL returning a collection, then processed in memory).

rule.title: DML potentiellement execute dans une boucle
rule.description: Une instruction DML (insert, update, upsert, delete) apparait dans une boucle.
rule.rationale: Les limites DML (150 statements/transaction) plafonnent le nombre d'iterations. C'est un anti-pattern reconnu du Well-Architected Framework (pilier Easy > Efficiency).
rule.remediation: Accumuler les enregistrements dans une List puis executer un seul DML apres la boucle.

translation.title: DML potentially executed inside a loop
translation.description: A DML statement (insert, update, upsert, delete) appears inside a loop.
translation.rationale: DML limits (150 statements per transaction) cap the number of iterations. This is a well-known anti-pattern of the Well-Architected Framework (Easy > Efficiency pillar).
translation.remediation: Collect the records into a List, then run a single DML statement after the loop.

rule.title: Callout HTTP potentiellement execute dans une boucle
rule.description: Une instance Http/HttpRequest est construite a l'interieur d'une boucle 'for' ou 'while', signe d'un callout synchrone repete.
rule.rationale: Les limites Apex plafonnent a 100 callouts par transaction, avec un temps cumule maximum de 120 secondes. Un callout emis a chaque iteration atteint rapidement ces plafonds et fait echouer la transaction (CalloutException), en plus de degrader fortement la latence percue.
rule.remediation: Sortir le callout de la boucle en le bulkifiant (endpoint batch cote service externe), ou differer les appels via des Queueable/Batch Apex distincts qui respectent les limites par job.

translation.title: HTTP callout potentially executed inside a loop
translation.description: An Http/HttpRequest instance is built inside a 'for' or 'while' loop, a sign of a repeated synchronous callout.
translation.rationale: Apex limits cap callouts at 100 per transaction, with a cumulative maximum of 120 seconds. A callout issued on every iteration reaches those ceilings quickly and fails the transaction (CalloutException), on top of badly degrading perceived latency.
translation.remediation: Move the callout out of the loop by bulkifying it (batch endpoint on the external service side), or defer the calls to separate Queueable/Batch Apex jobs that honour the per-job limits.

rule.title: Methode Apex suspectee de recursion sans garde
rule.description: Une methode est invoquee depuis son propre corps avec la meme signature (nom, nombre et types des arguments), sans mecanisme visible de garde de reentrance (variable statique, compteur, Set d'Ids deja traites). Une delegation vers une surcharge de meme nom mais de signature differente n'est pas signalee.
rule.rationale: Une recursion mal bornee epuise rapidement les limites gouverneurs (CPU time, heap, DML/SOQL) et provoque une LimitException ou un StackOverflow. Dans Salesforce la recursion est souvent involontaire, par exemple via un helper appele depuis un trigger qui re-ecrit les donnees d'origine. Le pilier Trusted > Reliable impose des garde-fous explicites.
rule.remediation: Supprimer la recursion si elle est involontaire, ou ajouter une garde (Set<Id> ou compteur static) qui empeche une seconde reentree pour le meme scope.

translation.title: Apex method suspected of unguarded recursion
translation.description: A method is invoked from its own body with the same signature (name, argument count and types), with no visible reentrancy guard (static variable, counter, Set of already processed IDs). Delegation to a same-named overload with a different signature is not reported.
translation.rationale: Poorly bounded recursion quickly exhausts governor limits (CPU time, heap, DML/SOQL) and raises a LimitException or a StackOverflow. In Salesforce, recursion is often unintentional, for instance through a helper called from a trigger that rewrites the original data. The Trusted > Reliable pillar mandates explicit safeguards.
translation.remediation: Remove the recursion if it is unintentional, or add a guard (Set<Id> or static counter) preventing a second entry for the same scope.

rule.title: Cycle d'appels detecte entre plusieurs classes Apex
rule.description: La classe participe a un cycle d'invocations avec d'autres classes Apex (A appelle B, B appelle A, ou cycle plus long). Un tel graphe d'appels peut boucler sans controle.
rule.rationale: Un cycle d'appels entre classes rend l'execution difficile a borner : chaque passage peut re-declencher la chaine via un trigger, un handler ou un service. Cela complique aussi la maintenance (impossible de tester une classe sans simuler son partenaire) et entre en contradiction avec les piliers Trusted > Reliable et Adaptable > Composable qui recommandent des graphes d'appels acycliques.
rule.remediation: Casser le cycle en introduisant une interface ou un service intermediaire, ou en deplacant la responsabilite commune dans une classe "socle" qui ne rappelle pas ses appelants.

translation.title: Call cycle detected between several Apex classes
translation.description: The class takes part in an invocation cycle with other Apex classes (A calls B, B calls A, or a longer cycle). Such a call graph can loop without control.
translation.rationale: A call cycle between classes makes execution hard to bound: every pass can re-trigger the chain through a trigger, a handler or a service. It also complicates maintenance (a class cannot be tested without simulating its partner) and contradicts the Trusted > Reliable and Adaptable > Composable pillars, which recommend acyclic call graphs.
translation.remediation: Break the cycle by introducing an interface or an intermediate service, or by moving the shared responsibility into a foundation class that never calls its callers back.

rule.title: Classe Apex trop longue
rule.description: Classe depassant 500 lignes de code hors commentaires et lignes vides, seuil propose par PMD pour les composants Apex.
rule.rationale: Une classe longue melange souvent plusieurs responsabilites et complique la lecture, les tests et les evolutions (Easy > Readability + Adaptable > Separation of Concerns).
rule.remediation: Scinder la classe en composants specialises (service, selector, domain, helper) selon le pattern Separation of Concerns.

translation.title: Apex class too long
translation.description: Class longer than 500 code lines, excluding comments and blank lines, the threshold suggested by PMD for Apex components.
translation.rationale: A long class often mixes several responsibilities and makes reading, testing and evolving harder (Easy > Readability and Adaptable > Separation of Concerns).
translation.remediation: Split the class into specialised components (service, selector, domain, helper) following the Separation of Concerns pattern.

rule.title: Densite de commentaires faible
rule.description: Moins de 5% de lignes commentees sur une classe depassant 80 lignes.
rule.rationale: La lisibilite est un attribut cle du pilier Easy. Une classe metier moyenne doit presenter les intentions (pourquoi) plus que la mecanique (comment).
rule.remediation: Ajouter un en-tete de classe (but, inputs, side effects) et commenter les passages non triviaux (algorithmes, regles metier).

translation.title: Low comment density
translation.description: Fewer than 5% commented lines in a class longer than 80 lines.
translation.rationale: Readability is a key attribute of the Easy pillar. An average business class should convey intent (why) more than mechanics (how).
translation.remediation: Add a class header (purpose, inputs, side effects) and comment the non-trivial parts (algorithms, business rules).

rule.title: Trop de System.debug non nettoyes
rule.description: Plus de 10 appels 'System.debug' dans la classe.
rule.rationale: Les traces System.debug degradent les performances et polluent les logs en production. Well-Architected pilier Trusted > Reliable recommande un dispositif de logs maitrise.
rule.remediation: Remplacer par un logger centralise activable via Custom Setting ou Custom Metadata; supprimer les traces residuelles.

translation.title: Too many leftover System.debug calls
translation.description: More than 10 'System.debug' calls in the class.
translation.rationale: System.debug traces degrade performance and pollute production logs. The Well-Architected Trusted > Reliable pillar recommends a controlled logging mechanism.
translation.remediation: Replace them with a central logger that can be toggled through a Custom Setting or Custom Metadata; remove the leftover traces.

rule.title: Logique metier directement dans le trigger
rule.description: Le trigger contient plus de 10 lignes non-commentaire ou des DML/SOQL inline.
rule.rationale: Le pattern Separation of Concerns (pilier Adaptable) recommande un Trigger Handler dedie. Un trigger qui porte la logique devient impossible a re-orchestrer ou tester unitairement.
rule.remediation: Appliquer un framework Trigger Handler (fflib, TriggerHandler, ou maison) et deplacer toute la logique dans la classe handler.

translation.title: Business logic directly inside the trigger
translation.description: The trigger contains more than 10 non-comment lines, or inline DML/SOQL.
translation.rationale: The Separation of Concerns pattern (Adaptable pillar) recommends a dedicated Trigger Handler. A trigger that carries the logic becomes impossible to re-orchestrate or unit test.
translation.remediation: Apply a Trigger Handler framework (fflib, TriggerHandler, or in-house) and move all the logic into the handler class.

rule.title: Trigger after insert/update re-ecrivant les enregistrements declencheurs
rule.description: Un trigger "after insert" ou "after update" execute un DML (update / upsert / Database.update) sur Trigger.new, Trigger.newMap ou une copie de ces collections, ce qui re-declenche immediatement le meme trigger.
rule.rationale: Dans un trigger after-save, toute mise a jour des enregistrements declencheurs est re-interceptee par Apex et relance la chaine complete des triggers. Sans garde (classe statique, flag Set<Id>), la transaction consomme les limites gouverneur (CPU, DML, SOQL) ou leve une LimitException. C'est un des pieges les plus frequents des triggers Salesforce et un anti-pattern explicite du pilier Trusted > Reliable.
rule.remediation: Effectuer la mise a jour des champs de l'enregistrement dans un "before insert" / "before update" (pas besoin de DML), ou introduire un TriggerHandler avec un Set<Id> statique qui empeche la reentrance.

translation.title: After insert/update trigger rewriting its triggering records
translation.description: An 'after insert' or 'after update' trigger runs a DML (update / upsert / Database.update) on Trigger.new, Trigger.newMap or a copy of those collections, which immediately re-fires the same trigger.
translation.rationale: In an after-save trigger, any update of the triggering records is intercepted again by Apex and restarts the whole trigger chain. Without a guard (static class, Set<Id> flag) the transaction burns governor limits (CPU, DML, SOQL) or raises a LimitException. This is one of the most frequent Salesforce trigger pitfalls and an explicit anti-pattern of the Trusted > Reliable pillar.
translation.remediation: Set the record fields in a 'before insert' / 'before update' context instead (no DML needed), or introduce a TriggerHandler with a static Set<Id> that prevents reentrancy.

rule.title: SOQL ou DML dans une boucle du trigger
rule.description: Le trigger realise des operations de donnees au sein d'une boucle.
rule.rationale: Les triggers sont invoques en mode bulk (jusqu'a 200 enregistrements). Une operation dans une boucle epuise les limites des la premiere chaine de creation massive.
rule.remediation: Bulkifier : collecter les Ids / enregistrements dans des Maps et effectuer une requete ou un DML unique.

translation.title: SOQL or DML inside a trigger loop
translation.description: The trigger performs data operations inside a loop.
translation.rationale: Triggers are invoked in bulk mode (up to 200 records). An operation inside a loop exhausts the limits as soon as the first mass creation chain runs.
translation.remediation: Bulkify: collect the IDs / records into Maps and run a single query or DML statement.

rule.source: Well-Architected Easy Readability + Admin Best Practices
rule.title: Flow sans description globale
rule.description: Le flow ne fournit pas de description au niveau metadata.
rule.rationale: Un flow sans description est difficile a reprendre. Les guides Salesforce Admins insistent sur la documentation immediate des automatisations (intention, declencheur, perimetre).
rule.remediation: Renseigner la description du flow : intention, declencheur, consequences sur les donnees, proprietaire.

translation.title: Flow without a global description
translation.description: The flow provides no description at the metadata level.
translation.rationale: A flow without a description is hard to pick up. The Salesforce Admins guides insist on documenting automations immediately (intent, trigger, scope).
translation.remediation: Fill in the flow description: intent, trigger, impact on data, owner.

rule.title: Taux d'elements decrits inferieur a 50%
rule.description: Moins d'un element de flow sur deux porte une description.
rule.rationale: Un flow lisible garde chaque element auto-descriptif. C'est un pattern explicite du pilier Easy.
rule.remediation: Ajouter une description sur les elements cles (decisions, actions, subflows) pour expliciter le 'pourquoi'.

translation.title: Fewer than 50% of elements described
translation.description: Fewer than one flow element in two carries a description.
translation.rationale: A readable flow keeps every element self-describing. This is an explicit pattern of the Easy pillar.
translation.remediation: Add a description to the key elements (decisions, actions, subflows) to make the 'why' explicit.

rule.title: Flow volumineux
rule.description: Flow comportant plus de 40 elements.
rule.rationale: Un flow volumineux devient un point de maintenance unique et fragile. Le pattern recommande un decoupage en sous-flows reutilisables (Adaptable > Composable).
rule.remediation: Extraire les sequences cohesives dans des sous-flows nommes; documenter chaque sous-flow individuellement.

translation.title: Oversized flow
translation.description: Flow with more than 40 elements.
translation.rationale: An oversized flow becomes a single, fragile maintenance point. The recommended pattern is to split it into reusable subflows (Adaptable > Composable).
translation.remediation: Extract the cohesive sequences into named subflows; document each subflow individually.

rule.title: Trop de decisions dans le flow
rule.description: Plus de 8 decisions dans un seul flow.
rule.rationale: Un fort branchement complique la couverture fonctionnelle et les tests. Well-Architected recommande de factoriser les regles en Decision Tables ou Custom Metadata-driven.
rule.remediation: Remplacer certaines cascades de decisions par des Decision Tables / Custom Metadata, ou scinder le flow.

translation.title: Too many decisions in the flow
translation.description: More than 8 decisions in a single flow.
translation.rationale: Heavy branching complicates functional coverage and testing. Well-Architected recommends factoring the rules into Decision Tables or Custom Metadata-driven configuration.
translation.remediation: Replace some decision cascades with Decision Tables / Custom Metadata, or split the flow.

rule.title: Beaucoup d'operations de donnees
rule.description: Plus de 6 operations recordCreate/recordUpdate/recordDelete/recordLookup.
rule.rationale: Chaque operation de donnees consomme des limites. Un flow qui enchaine les DML risque d'echec en transaction et degrade l'experience utilisateur.
rule.remediation: Regrouper les operations (Collections + Update Records), ou deleguer a de l'Apex bulkifie pour les traitements complexes.

translation.title: Heavy data footprint
translation.description: More than 6 recordCreate/recordUpdate/recordDelete/recordLookup operations.
translation.rationale: Every data operation consumes limits. A flow chaining DML statements risks transaction failures and degrades the user experience.
translation.remediation: Group the operations (Collections + Update Records), or delegate to bulkified Apex for complex processing.

rule.title: Profondeur d'imbrication excessive
rule.description: Le flow presente une profondeur superieure a 4.
rule.rationale: Au-dela de 4 niveaux d'imbrication, le suivi visuel et la maintenance deviennent difficiles.
rule.remediation: Aplatir la structure en scindant les branches profondes en sous-flows nommes.

translation.title: Excessive nesting depth
translation.description: The flow has a depth greater than 4.
translation.rationale: Beyond 4 nesting levels, visual tracking and maintenance become difficult.
translation.remediation: Flatten the structure by splitting the deep branches into named subflows.

rule.title: Flow inactif present dans le package
rule.description: Le flow n'est pas a l'etat 'Active'.
rule.rationale: Les flows inactifs alourdissent le package et peuvent reveler une migration inachevee.
rule.remediation: Activer le flow s'il est utilise, ou le supprimer / archiver s'il ne sert plus.

translation.title: Inactive flow present in the package
translation.description: The flow is not in the 'Active' state.
translation.rationale: Inactive flows bloat the package and may reveal an unfinished migration.
translation.remediation: Activate the flow if it is used, or delete / archive it if it is no longer needed.

rule.title: SOQL (Get Records) dans une boucle de Flow
rule.description: Une operation de lecture de donnees apparait dans une boucle, ce qui risque d'atteindre les limites de gouverneur.
rule.rationale: Comme en Apex, les operations de base de donnees dans les boucles de Flow sont couteuses et risquent de depasser les limites (100 requetes par transaction).
rule.remediation: Extraire le 'Get Records' avant la boucle ou utiliser des collections pour traiter les donnees en masse.

translation.title: SOQL (Get Records) inside a Flow loop
translation.description: A data read operation appears inside a loop, which risks hitting governor limits.
translation.rationale: As in Apex, database operations inside Flow loops are expensive and risk exceeding the limits (100 queries per transaction).
translation.remediation: Move the 'Get Records' before the loop, or use collections to process the data in bulk.

rule.title: DML (Create/Update/Delete) dans une boucle de Flow
rule.description: Une operation d'ecriture de donnees apparait dans une boucle.
rule.rationale: Les operations DML dans les boucles de Flow sont un anti-pattern majeur. Elles provoquent des echecs de transaction des que le volume d'enregistrements augmente.
rule.remediation: Accumuler les changements dans une variable de collection et effectuer un seul 'Update Records' ou 'Create Records' a la sortie de la boucle.

translation.title: DML (Create/Update/Delete) inside a Flow loop
translation.description: A data write operation appears inside a loop.
translation.rationale: DML operations inside Flow loops are a major anti-pattern. They cause transaction failures as soon as the record volume grows.
translation.remediation: Accumulate the changes in a collection variable and run a single 'Update Records' or 'Create Records' after the loop.

rule.title: Appel d'action externe (External Service) dans une boucle de Flow
rule.description: Une action de type External Service (appel HTTP vers un systeme externe) apparait dans une boucle.
rule.rationale: Chaque iteration declenche un appel HTTP synchrone vers un systeme externe. Les limites Apex/Flow plafonnent a 100 callouts par transaction (120 secondes cumulees) ; un appel repete a chaque iteration atteint rapidement ces plafonds et degrade fortement la latence percue.
rule.remediation: Sortir l'appel externe de la boucle en bulkifiant la requete (endpoint batch cote systeme externe) ou en accumulant les entrees pour un seul appel groupe a la sortie de la boucle.

translation.title: External Service action call inside a Flow loop
translation.description: An External Service action (HTTP call to an external system) appears inside a loop.
translation.rationale: Every iteration fires a synchronous HTTP call to an external system. Apex/Flow limits cap callouts at 100 per transaction (120 cumulative seconds); a call repeated on each iteration reaches those ceilings quickly and badly degrades perceived latency.
translation.remediation: Move the external call out of the loop by bulkifying the request (batch endpoint on the external system side) or by accumulating the inputs for a single grouped call after the loop.

rule.source: Salesforce Flow Fault Paths + Well-Architected Reliable
rule.title: Element de Flow sans chemin d'erreur (fault path)
rule.description: Detecte les elements susceptibles d'echouer a l'execution (Get/Create/Update/Delete Records, Action, Pause) qui ne declarent pas de faultConnector.
rule.rationale: Sans chemin d'erreur, une exception non geree interrompt la transaction : l'utilisateur d'un screen flow recoit un message technique illisible et, en mode autolaunched, l'erreur n'est visible que dans l'e-mail d'echec adresse a l'auteur du flow. Le pilier Trusted / Reliable impose une gestion explicite des erreurs.
rule.remediation: Ajouter un chemin d'erreur sur chaque element concerne : afficher un ecran d'erreur explicite (screen flow), journaliser l'incident dans un objet de log et/ou notifier l'equipe support via $Flow.FaultMessage.

translation.title: Flow element without a fault path
translation.description: Detects the elements that can fail at runtime (Get/Create/Update/Delete Records, Action, Pause) and declare no faultConnector.
translation.rationale: Without a fault path, an unhandled exception aborts the transaction: a screen flow user gets an unreadable technical message and, in autolaunched mode, the error is only visible in the failure e-mail sent to the flow author. The Trusted / Reliable pillar mandates explicit error handling.
translation.remediation: Add a fault path on each affected element: show an explicit error screen (screen flow), log the incident into a logging object and/or notify the support team through $Flow.FaultMessage.

rule.title: Composant LWC JS trop volumineux
rule.description: Le fichier Javascript du composant depasse 300 lignes.
rule.rationale: Un fichier JS trop long devient difficile a maintenir et a tester. Il est preferable de decouper la logique en modules de service ou en sous-composants.
rule.remediation: Extraire la logique metier dans des fichiers JS partages ou scinder le composant en plus petites unites.

translation.title: LWC JavaScript component too large
translation.description: The component JavaScript file exceeds 300 lines.
translation.rationale: An overly long JS file becomes hard to maintain and test. Splitting the logic into service modules or sub-components is preferable.
translation.remediation: Extract the business logic into shared JS files, or split the component into smaller units.

rule.title: Template LWC HTML trop volumineux
rule.description: Le fichier HTML du composant depasse 200 lignes.
rule.rationale: Un template HTML trop long nuit a la lisibilite et a la reutilisation de l'UI.
rule.remediation: Decouper l'interface en sous-composants fonctionnels.

translation.title: LWC HTML template too large
translation.description: The component HTML file exceeds 200 lines.
translation.rationale: An overly long HTML template hurts readability and UI reuse.
translation.remediation: Split the interface into functional sub-components.

rule.title: Utilisation de @AuraEnabled dans un LWC
rule.description: Le composant appelle des methodes Apex via @AuraEnabled.
rule.rationale: Les appels Apex depuis le frontend sont des points d'entree critiques. Ils doivent etre audites pour s'assurer que les controles de securite (with sharing, CRUD/FLS) sont bien en place.
rule.remediation: Verifier que la classe Apex appelee respecte les regles de securite et n'expose pas de donnees sensibles.

translation.title: Use of @AuraEnabled in an LWC
translation.description: The component calls Apex methods through @AuraEnabled.
translation.rationale: Apex calls from the frontend are critical entry points. They must be audited to make sure the security controls (with sharing, CRUD/FLS) are in place.
translation.remediation: Check that the Apex class being called enforces the security rules and does not expose sensitive data.

rule.title: Presence de console.log dans le code LWC
rule.description: Le code JS contient des appels a console.log ou console.error.
rule.rationale: Les logs console doivent etre reserves au developpement et ne pas etre presents dans le code de production pour des raisons de performance et de proprete des logs.
rule.remediation: Supprimer les appels console.log ou utiliser un service de logging dedie.

translation.title: console.log present in the LWC code
translation.description: The JS code contains calls to console.log or console.error.
translation.rationale: Console logs should be limited to development and must not ship in production code, for both performance and log cleanliness reasons.
translation.remediation: Remove the console.log calls or use a dedicated logging service.

rule.title: Composant LWC sans label ou description
rule.description: Le composant n'a pas de masterLabel ou de description dans son fichier de configuration.
rule.rationale: Un composant sans description est plus difficile a identifier et a reutiliser dans l'App Builder.
rule.remediation: Renseigner le masterLabel et la description dans le fichier .js-meta.xml.

translation.title: LWC component without a label or description
translation.description: The component has no masterLabel or description in its configuration file.
translation.rationale: A component without a description is harder to identify and reuse in App Builder.
translation.remediation: Fill in the masterLabel and the description in the .js-meta.xml file.

rule.title: Composant Aura volumineux
rule.description: Le composant Aura depasse les seuils de taille recommandes (200 lignes CMP / 300 lignes JS).
rule.rationale: Les composants Aura sont plus difficiles a optimiser et a maintenir que les LWC. Un composant Aura complexe est un candidat prioritaire pour une migration vers LWC.
rule.remediation: Envisager une reecriture en Lightning Web Components (LWC) pour de meilleures performances et une maintenance simplifiee.

translation.title: Oversized Aura component
translation.description: The Aura component exceeds the recommended size thresholds (200 CMP lines / 300 JS lines).
translation.rationale: Aura components are harder to optimise and maintain than LWC. A complex Aura component is a priority candidate for migration to LWC.
translation.remediation: Consider rewriting it as a Lightning Web Component (LWC) for better performance and simpler maintenance.

rule.title: Objet personnalise sans description
rule.description: Un objet custom ne dispose d'aucune description au niveau metadata.
rule.rationale: Les objets metier sont la colonne vertebrale du modele. Sans description, les developpeurs et admins n'ont aucun point d'entree pour comprendre leur role.
rule.remediation: Renseigner la description de l'objet : role fonctionnel, granularite, relations principales.

translation.title: Custom object without a description
translation.description: A custom object has no description at the metadata level.
translation.rationale: Business objects are the backbone of the model. Without a description, developers and admins have no entry point to understand their role.
translation.remediation: Fill in the object description: functional role, granularity, main relationships.

rule.title: Objet avec un grand nombre de champs personnalises
rule.description: Plus de 50 champs custom sur un seul objet.
rule.rationale: Un objet surcharge signale souvent un manque de normalisation. Le Decision Guide Salesforce recommande d'envisager un eclatement (sous-objet, objet referentiel) pour garder l'agilite.
rule.remediation: Evaluer un decoupage en objets satellites ou l'utilisation de Custom Metadata pour les donnees de reference.

translation.title: Object with a large number of custom fields
translation.description: More than 50 custom fields on a single object.
translation.rationale: An overloaded object often signals a lack of normalisation. The Salesforce Decision Guide recommends considering a split (child object, reference object) to stay agile.
translation.remediation: Assess a split into satellite objects, or the use of Custom Metadata for reference data.

rule.title: Beaucoup de validation rules sur l'objet
rule.description: Plus de 10 validation rules actives sur le meme objet.
rule.rationale: Un objet sature de validation rules complique le diagnostic des erreurs utilisateur et le debogage. Considerer Regles Duplication + Custom Metadata + Flows ecran.
rule.remediation: Consolider les regles similaires, factoriser via Custom Metadata ou Flows avant sauvegarde quand pertinent.

translation.title: Many validation rules on the object
translation.description: More than 10 active validation rules on the same object.
translation.rationale: An object saturated with validation rules complicates user error diagnosis and debugging. Consider Duplicate Rules + Custom Metadata + screen Flows.
translation.remediation: Consolidate similar rules, factor them through Custom Metadata or before-save Flows where relevant.

rule.title: Plusieurs record types actifs
rule.description: Plus de 3 record types actifs sur le meme objet.
rule.rationale: Les record types multiples facilitent la segmentation mais demultiplient les configurations (layouts, picklists, permissions). Surveiller le ROI de chacun.
rule.remediation: Documenter le role de chaque record type; fusionner ceux qui convergent.

translation.title: Several active record types
translation.description: More than 3 active record types on the same object.
translation.rationale: Multiple record types help segmentation but multiply the configuration (layouts, picklists, permissions). Keep an eye on the return on investment of each one.
translation.remediation: Document the role of each record type; merge the ones that converge.

rule.source: Well-Architected Easy Readability + Admins Best Practices
rule.title: Champ personnalise sans description
rule.description: Un champ custom (__c) ne porte ni description ni help text.
rule.rationale: Les champs sans metadata textuelle freinent la gouvernance et l'adoption utilisateur. Salesforce Admins recommande systematiquement description + help text pour chaque champ custom.
rule.remediation: Ajouter une description technique et un help text fonctionnel pour chaque champ custom.

translation.title: Custom field without a description
translation.description: A custom field (__c) carries neither a description nor help text.
translation.rationale: Fields without textual metadata hinder governance and user adoption. Salesforce Admins systematically recommends a description plus help text for every custom field.
translation.remediation: Add a technical description and a functional help text to every custom field.

rule.title: Validation rule sans description
rule.description: La validation rule ne fournit pas de description.
rule.rationale: Sans description, il est impossible de comprendre la regle metier que la validation protege.
rule.remediation: Decrire en une phrase la regle metier et l'erreur utilisateur correspondante.

translation.title: Validation rule without a description
translation.description: The validation rule provides no description.
translation.rationale: Without a description it is impossible to understand the business rule the validation protects.
translation.remediation: Describe the business rule and the matching user-facing error in one sentence.

rule.title: Formule de validation tres longue
rule.description: La formule comporte plus de 500 caracteres ou plus de 8 operateurs logiques (AND/OR/NOT/IF).
rule.rationale: Une formule tentaculaire devient difficile a tester et a faire evoluer. Elle gagne a etre factorisee dans des formules intermediaires ou Custom Metadata.
rule.remediation: Decomposer en champs formules intermediaires, en Custom Metadata ou deplacer la regle dans un Flow / Apex si elle porte de la logique complexe.

translation.title: Very long validation formula
translation.description: The formula is longer than 500 characters or uses more than 8 logical operators (AND/OR/NOT/IF).
translation.rationale: A sprawling formula becomes hard to test and evolve. It benefits from being factored into intermediate formulas or Custom Metadata.
translation.remediation: Break it into intermediate formula fields or Custom Metadata, or move the rule into a Flow / Apex if it carries complex logic.

rule.title: Duplicate rule sans description
rule.description: La duplicate rule ne fournit pas de description.
rule.rationale: Une duplicate rule sans description est difficile a maintenir, surtout quand plusieurs regles s'appliquent au meme objet.
rule.remediation: Ajouter une description expliquant le cas d'usage et la strategie de deduplication.

translation.title: Duplicate rule without a description
translation.description: The duplicate rule provides no description.
translation.rationale: A duplicate rule without a description is hard to maintain, especially when several rules apply to the same object.
translation.remediation: Add a description explaining the use case and the deduplication strategy.

rule.title: Duplicate rule avec application des Sharing Rules
rule.description: La regle est configuree pour respecter les regles de partage (EnforceSharingRules).
rule.rationale: Si une duplicate rule respecte les sharing rules, elle ne detectera que les doublons parmi les enregistrements auxquels l'utilisateur a acces. Cela peut laisser passer des doublons reels presents dans l'org mais invisibles pour l'utilisateur.
rule.remediation: Evaluer si 'BypassSharingRules' est plus approprie pour garantir l'unicite globale des donnees.

translation.title: Duplicate rule enforcing sharing rules
translation.description: The rule is configured to honour the sharing rules (EnforceSharingRules).
translation.rationale: When a duplicate rule honours sharing rules, it only detects duplicates among the records the user can access. Real duplicates that exist in the org but are invisible to the user can slip through.
translation.remediation: Assess whether 'BypassSharingRules' is more appropriate to guarantee global data uniqueness.

rule.title: Data Transform sans description
rule.description: Le composant OmniStudio Data Transform ne porte pas de description.
rule.rationale: Les Data Transforms enchainent Extract / Transform / Load. Sans description, impossible de saisir leur role dans une chaine OmniScript / Integration Procedure.
rule.remediation: Ajouter une description : finalite metier, inputs attendus, outputs produits.

translation.title: Data Transform without a description
translation.description: The OmniStudio Data Transform component carries no description.
translation.rationale: Data Transforms chain Extract / Transform / Load steps. Without a description, their role in an OmniScript / Integration Procedure chain cannot be grasped.
translation.remediation: Add a description: business purpose, expected inputs, produced outputs.

rule.title: Items Data Transform desactives non nettoyes
rule.description: Plus de 3 omniDataTransformItem desactives persistent dans la definition.
rule.rationale: Les items desactives alourdissent la definition et trompent le lecteur. Ils doivent etre supprimes ou documentes.
rule.remediation: Supprimer les items devenus inutiles, ou documenter la raison de leur conservation.

translation.title: Disabled Data Transform items left behind
translation.description: More than 3 disabled omniDataTransformItem entries remain in the definition.
translation.rationale: Disabled items bloat the definition and mislead the reader. They should be removed or documented.
translation.remediation: Delete the items that are no longer needed, or document why they are kept.

rule.title: Data Transform volumineux
rule.description: Plus de 40 omniDataTransformItem dans un seul Data Transform.
rule.rationale: Un Data Transform monolithique devient difficile a tester et a faire evoluer. Le pattern Composable suggere un decoupage par domaine ou sous-flux.
rule.remediation: Decouper en plusieurs Data Transforms enchaines par une Integration Procedure; reutiliser des blocs par objet cible.

translation.title: Oversized Data Transform
translation.description: More than 40 omniDataTransformItem entries in a single Data Transform.
translation.rationale: A monolithic Data Transform becomes hard to test and evolve. The Composable pattern suggests splitting it by domain or sub-flow.
translation.remediation: Split it into several Data Transforms chained by an Integration Procedure; reuse blocks per target object.

rule.title: Agent sans description
rule.description: L'agent ne dispose d'aucune description au niveau metadata.
rule.rationale: Les agents (Agentforce) sont des composants complexes. Sans description, il est difficile de comprendre leur role, leur public cible et les capacites qu'ils exposent.
rule.remediation: Renseigner la description de l'agent : role, objectifs et perimetre d'action.

translation.title: Agent without a description
translation.description: The agent has no description at the metadata level.
translation.rationale: Agents (Agentforce) are complex components. Without a description it is hard to understand their role, their target audience and the capabilities they expose.
translation.remediation: Fill in the agent description: role, goals and scope of action.

rule.title: Prompt Template sans description
rule.description: Le prompt template ne dispose d'aucune description au niveau metadata.
rule.rationale: Un prompt sans description est une "boite noire". Pour garantir la maintenance et l'evolution des modeles generatifs, chaque template doit expliciter son intention et son contexte.
rule.remediation: Ajouter une description au prompt template expliquant le cas d'usage et le resultat attendu.

translation.title: Prompt Template without a description
translation.description: The prompt template has no description at the metadata level.
translation.rationale: A prompt without a description is a black box. To keep generative models maintainable and evolvable, every template must state its intent and its context.
translation.remediation: Add a description to the prompt template explaining the use case and the expected result.

rule.source: Well-Architected Data Security + Salesforce Security Guide
rule.title: Profil avec permission ModifyAllData
rule.description: Detecte un profil custom disposant de la user permission 'ModifyAllData', qui accorde un acces en ecriture total sur toutes les donnees de l'org.
rule.rationale: ModifyAllData est la permission la plus elevee sur les donnees. Sa presence dans un profil custom contourne toutes les regles de partage et les FLS, exposant l'integralite des donnees a modification. Le principe du moindre privilege exige que cette permission soit reservee aux seuls administrateurs systeme.
rule.remediation: Retirer la permission ModifyAllData du profil. Evaluer si un Permission Set dedie aux super-admins peut la porter a la place, avec une assignation nominative et auditee.

translation.title: Profile with the ModifyAllData permission
translation.description: Detects a custom profile holding the 'ModifyAllData' user permission, which grants full write access to every record in the org.
translation.rationale: ModifyAllData is the highest data permission. Its presence in a custom profile bypasses every sharing rule and FLS, exposing all data to modification. The least privilege principle requires this permission to be reserved for system administrators only.
translation.remediation: Remove the ModifyAllData permission from the profile. Assess whether a dedicated super-admin Permission Set can carry it instead, with named and audited assignment.

rule.source: Well-Architected Data Security + Salesforce Security Guide
rule.title: Profil avec permission ManageUsers
rule.description: Detecte un profil custom disposant de la user permission 'ManageUsers', qui permet de creer, modifier et desactiver des utilisateurs ainsi que d'assigner n'importe quel profil.
rule.rationale: ManageUsers est une permission a haut risque : un utilisateur qui la possede peut s'auto-elever en assignant un profil administrateur. Elle doit etre portee par des Permission Sets specifiques assignes aux seuls responsables RH/Salesforce, pas embarquee dans un profil large.
rule.remediation: Migrer la permission ManageUsers vers un Permission Set nomme et audite. Retirer la permission du profil.

translation.title: Profile with the ManageUsers permission
translation.description: Detects a custom profile holding the 'ManageUsers' user permission, which allows creating, editing and deactivating users as well as assigning any profile.
translation.rationale: ManageUsers is a high-risk permission: a user holding it can self-escalate by assigning an administrator profile. It should be carried by specific Permission Sets assigned to HR / Salesforce owners only, not embedded in a broad profile.
translation.remediation: Move the ManageUsers permission to a named and audited Permission Set. Remove the permission from the profile.

rule.title: Profil avec ModifyAllRecords sur un objet
rule.description: Detecte un profil custom accordant 'ModifyAllRecords' sur au moins un objet, contournant les regles de partage pour cet objet.
rule.rationale: ModifyAllRecords contourne les sharing rules et permet de modifier tous les enregistrements d'un objet independamment de la propriete. Ce privilege excessif au niveau profil viole le principe du moindre privilege et complexifie les audits de securite.
rule.remediation: Evaluer si ModifyAllRecords est necessaire pour tous les utilisateurs du profil. Si non, migrer ce droit vers un Permission Set assigne aux seuls utilisateurs qui en ont besoin.

translation.title: Profile with ModifyAllRecords on an object
translation.description: Detects a custom profile granting 'ModifyAllRecords' on at least one object, bypassing the sharing rules for that object.
translation.rationale: ModifyAllRecords bypasses sharing rules and allows editing every record of an object regardless of ownership. This excessive privilege at profile level violates the least privilege principle and complicates security audits.
translation.remediation: Assess whether ModifyAllRecords is needed by every user of the profile. If not, move that right to a Permission Set assigned only to the users who need it.

rule.title: Permission Set avec ModifyAllRecords sur objet sensible
rule.description: Detecte un Permission Set accordant 'ModifyAllRecords' sur un objet standard sensible (Account, Contact, Opportunity, Lead, Order, Case, Contract, User).
rule.rationale: Un Permission Set avec ModifyAllRecords sur un objet core du CRM peut etre assigne largement, contournant ainsi les regles de partage. Bien que les PS soient une meilleure pratique que les profils, des droits excessifs restent risques si le perimetre d'assignation n'est pas controle.
rule.remediation: Verifier la liste des utilisateurs ayant ce Permission Set. Limiter l'assignation aux utilisateurs ayant un besoin metier justifie. Envisager de fractionner le PS si certains utilisateurs n'ont pas besoin de ce niveau d'acces.

translation.title: Permission Set with ModifyAllRecords on a sensitive object
translation.description: Detects a Permission Set granting 'ModifyAllRecords' on a sensitive standard object (Account, Contact, Opportunity, Lead, Order, Case, Contract, User).
translation.rationale: A Permission Set with ModifyAllRecords on a core CRM object can be assigned broadly, bypassing the sharing rules. Although Permission Sets are a better practice than profiles, excessive rights remain risky when the assignment scope is not controlled.
translation.remediation: Review the list of users holding this Permission Set. Restrict the assignment to users with a justified business need. Consider splitting the Permission Set if some users do not need this level of access.

rule.title: Ratio eleve de profils custom vs Permission Sets
rule.description: Le nombre de profils custom est disproportionne par rapport au nombre de Permission Sets, indiquant une architecture de securite non optimisee.
rule.rationale: Salesforce recommande une approche "Permission Sets first" : un minimum de profils tres generiques complementes de Permission Sets specifiques assignes de maniere granulaire. Un ratio eleve de profils sur les PS signifie que les droits sont geres dans des silo, rendant la gouvernance complexe et les audits laborieux.
rule.remediation: Consolider les profils similaires, migrer les droits specifiques vers des Permission Sets ou des Permission Set Groups, et adopter une strategie de gouvernance des acces documentee.

translation.title: High ratio of custom profiles to Permission Sets
translation.description: The number of custom profiles is disproportionate to the number of Permission Sets, indicating a security architecture that is not optimised.
translation.rationale: Salesforce recommends a 'Permission Sets first' approach: a minimum of very generic profiles complemented by specific Permission Sets assigned granularly. A high profile-to-Permission-Set ratio means rights are managed in silos, making governance complex and audits laborious.
translation.remediation: Consolidate similar profiles, migrate specific rights to Permission Sets or Permission Set Groups, and adopt a documented access governance strategy.
